name: GoDaddy
summary: Domain registrar and web hosting provider.

flows.title: Add an A record to a domain
steps: In the Domain Portfolio, select the domain to open its Domain Settings page, then select DNS to view its DNS records.
Select Add New Record, then select A from the Type menu.

For Name, enter @ to put the record on the root domain, or a prefix such as blog to make a subdomain. For Value, enter the IP address the record points to, commonly a hosting account's. The TTL defaults to 1 hour.
Select Save. For a domain with Domain Protection, GoDaddy then asks the account owner to confirm their identity.

flows.title: Forward a domain to another website
steps: In the Domain Portfolio, select the domain to open its Domain Settings page, then select DNS and then Forwarding.
Select Add Forwarding. Choose Domain to forward the root domain, or Subdomain to forward a subdomain and enter the subdomain.
Choose http:// or https:// for the destination, and enter the destination URL visitors should be sent to.
Choose the forwarding type: Permanent (301), Temporary (302), or Forward with masking, which keeps the domain in the address bar.
Select Save. For a domain with Domain Protection, GoDaddy then asks the account owner to confirm their identity.
